lens_notes.producer_propagation: Planned scenario, pose and playback feed drive_sequence, native pose/capture observations then FrameSample, screenshots and output. The P17 SignedLength and fallible sample admission are not silently transferred to current f32 state; current aliases and native delivery remain scoped separately.
lens_notes.type_ownership: CaptureSequence owns per-run, plan-index and admission state; CompletedCapture moves results to report output. CaptureAdmission owns typed terminal causes. The snapshot change between report-p17 and pr-working changes which numeric observation owner actually propagates.
lens_notes.type_granularity: A frame, screenshot view, simulation tick, settle/wait counters and in-flight request denote different stages; local view fingerprint is only an image comparison heuristic. Optional no-IK/ragdoll modes are deliberate.
lens_notes.admission_contracts: Known scenario branch and authored plan have typed inputs; current unsupported selection can reach assert within a Result constructor, already q46. Terrain/geometry/locomotion rejections are owned; neither finite inputs nor an archived improved variant proves every current computed observation admitted.
lens_notes.invariant_operations: Current distance += speed * elapsed has no local re-admission; P17 admission.rs 129–143 rechecks SignedLength result. Supported overflow is unproved. P17 sample independently preserves selected optional diagnostics and typed bouncy error until rejection.
lens_notes.enum_shapes: Open/Rejected(cause)/Terminated correctly differentiate terminal outcomes. Distinguish not applied, waiting for required motion, rendering in flight and view completion; they presently combine boolean and counters, but a redesign requires the actual liveness contract.
lens_notes.aggregate_states: Sequence plan/index, per-view evidence and asynchronous screenshot completion must refer to the same logical sample. Existing artifact certificate q206 concerns actual persistence; callback delivery/no-progress is a separate still-unproven lifecycle question.
lens_notes.magic_numbers: The 60-frame initial settle, two-frame per-view settle, 1200-frame selected wait, sample stride and thresholds perform distinct jobs. Their timing assumptions require schedule/asset/native policy, not indiscriminate numeric wrapping.
lens_notes.magic_strings: Scenario and view owners are typed before native labels. View keys become BTreeMap<String,String> before report internal lookup, already q545. Error messages are formatted at terminal output; no generic ban on final prose.
lens_notes.existing_type_owners: P17 SignedLength, UnitInterval and named CaptureView are real existing owners in their own snapshot; current usage and intended compatibility need current-aware reconciliation, not restoration of the older branch. Existing IK error and rejected admission owners remain available.
lens_notes.redundant_authority: FrameSample snapshot versus plan and repeated-evaluation baseline are different expected and observed facts. Raised-footwork retained support may override admitted propagated diagnostics, already q45; only the complete original causal owner chain establishes an alias.
lens_notes.behavior_preservation: Preserve no-IK cadence fallback, FullRagdoll omission from authored jitter, explicit warmup, three ordered views, logical screenshot framing, retained typed failure causes and terminal error exit. Never interpret historical P17 as automatically restored or current.
lens_notes.derivability: Existing derives for ECS/serialization and structured state are small native constructs. No field-by-field boilerplate removal or serialization rewrite established by the bounded bodies.
